text: The following recommendation has been drafted by Transportation Staff to address an urgent concern related to parked vehicles impeding driveway and road access to a section of Dunmail Drive. I would kindly ask that Scarborough Community Council adopt the following recommendation to ensure residents and emergency services may move freely.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east side of Dunmail Drive, between a point 100 metres west and south of Blue Eagle Trail (north intersection) and a point 32 metres further south.
